title: Disney's FastPass: A Complicated History
summary: A feature-length Defunctland documentary on the history of Disney's FastPass and FastPass+ expedited queue systems. It covers how the systems evolved and how they were designed, with simulation of their effects on park lines.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible, engrossing lesson in queueing theory and systems design, even for people with no interest in Disney.

quote.text: If you ever wanted a feature-length explanation of queueing theory and how ignoring it makes everything worse, well... here you go
